Re: The Crystal Year

As far as i remember it was written in commemoration of crystal year of b.finnegan’s friends - it’s like golden, silver and so on year of life together, - i forgot how many years is “crystal”.
Brian told us about it on the flook concert here in november.

The Crystal Year, X:5

Brian Finnegan mentionned the tune as a Waltz, so i think it’s more appropriate in 3/4 than 12/8. Brian Finnegan in mentionned as the composer of this tune on the album “ancora” by Flook.
